    base=[eps*np.exp(-p*eps)*T**q]
    if opt=='A': cols=base+[np.exp(-E/T),L]
    if opt=='B': cols=base+[np.exp(-E/T),L*T**th[3]]
    if opt=='C': cols=base+[L*np.exp(-E/T),np.ones_like(eps)]
    if opt=='D': cols=base+[np.exp(-E/T)*L,np.ones_like(eps)]
    if opt=='E': cols=base+[L*T**th[3],np.ones_like(eps)]
    if opt=='F': cols=base+[eps**th[3]*L*T**th[4]]
    return np.c_[tuple(cols)]
def rs(th,opt):
    X=mk(th,opt); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]; return sigma-X@c
